description: Source code for Android's Surface class utilities, including parceling and unparceling of native window surfaces, with functions for writing to and reading from parcels, and handling surface-related data structures.

classes.name: Surface
classes.description: Represents a native window surface with parceling capabilities, including methods for serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the Surface object into a Parcel.

methods.name: writeToParcel (overload)
methods.description: Serializes the Surface object into a Parcel, with an option indicating if the name is already written.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes the Surface object from a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel (overload)
methods.description: Deserializes the Surface object from a Parcel, with an option if the name has already been read.

methods.name: readMaybeEmptyString16
methods.description: Reads a String16 from a Parcel, returning an empty String16 if none is present.
